recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, sepia-toned composition featuring a large, faint, close-up facial portrait in the background acting as a landscape for a sequence of five full-body figures in various stages of rising from a seated to a standing position.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the ethereal background face and the sharp foreground figures
Horizontal progression from left to right showing physical movement
Tonal harmony between the warm sepia background and the stark black-and-white clothing
coreInvariants: High-key white floor blending into a textured sepia background
Progression of a single subject in different poses

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale face occupies the upper two-thirds; small-scale figures occupy the bottom horizontal strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The standing figure on the far right provides a vertical anchor to the horizontal sequence.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right reading flow following the rising motion of the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the center, occupied only by the faint features of the background face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/beige for the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for trousers and jackets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for shirts and the floor plane.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the clothing and the background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Connecting 'of' is rendered in a fluid, calligraphic italic script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: All-caps serif for names paired with a delicate script for prepositions.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and high contrast match the elegant tone.
Offers a similar wide-spaced, light-weight serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned image with a canvas texture. In the background, a very faint, large-scale close-up of a man's eyes and nose. In the foreground, a sequence of five men in black suits and white shirts, progressing from lying down on the left to standing on the right, all on a bright white floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text at the top using a wide-spaced serif font in all caps, with the word 'of' in a small, elegant italic script.

verificationChecks: Is the background face sufficiently faint?
Does the figure progression feel fluid from left to right?
Is the text tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Is the sepia tone consistent across the upper half?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the progression
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the floor is pure white and blends seamlessly into the sepia background.
Check that the text is perfectly centered and legible against the background.
Verify the figures are sharp while the background face remains ethereal.
Confirm the canvas texture is subtle and does not obscure details.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a stroboscopic movement sequence in the foreground with a low-opacity, large-scale portrait in the background, tied together by a warm monochromatic palette and wide-spaced serif typography.
